Region: United States (Table 2, 2001) and California (Table 4, 2001). Locators are PRINTED page numbers. Loaded: per-bbl fuel, steam and electricity for 14 refinery process units plus hydrogen (per lb) and sulfur (per short ton), derived by the extractor from the printed 2001 U.S. totals divided by printed throughput; and a whole-industry U.S. average per bbl crude (low mapping). Table 2 is the authors' estimate built from Gary and Handwerk intensities and EIA throughput, not measured unit data. TRAPS: (1) Table 2 throughput header reads "Million bbl/day" but note 1 says million bbl/YEAR (values only make sense per year). (2) Process fuel excludes boiler fuel; steam is loaded as a separate final carrier. (3) Electricity at 3412 Btu/kWh in Final; primary not loaded. (4) California Table 4 is integer TBtu on capacity not throughput, kept in other-values. (5) No capex/opex. No cost data, no per-refinery configurations beyond capacity (Fig. 13). Measures (Sect. 5) are mostly literature reprints. Heating-value basis not stated.
